#FPReels: Netanyahu's Office Debunks "Fake" Social Media Claims of His Death 

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office has dismissed social media claims of his assassination. “These are fake news; the Prime Minister is fine,” his office said in a statement. This comes as Iran vows to "pursue and kill" Netanyahu. | Firstpost | Facebook
